significado: The feeling of relief and satisfaction from skipping events, commitments, or trends.
exemplo_correto: Everyone went out clubbing, but I stayed home watching a show, pure jomo.
exemplos_incorretos: The recipe called for a pinch of jomo to flavor the sauce.
The electrician replaced the burnt-out jomo in the kitchen outlet.
I bought a new jomo to decorate the living room shelf.
significados_incorretos: A seasoning or spice used in regional dishes.
An electrical component used in home wiring.
A decorative object used indoors.
impacto_motivo: Jomo refers to the calm pleasure of skipping obligations, associated with well-being and self-care.

significado: To power through a tough situation, holding up under criticism, pressure, or problems without falling apart.
exemplo_correto: Exam week was brutal, but I tanked through it all without giving up.
exemplos_incorretos: The truck carried a full tank of fuel on its bed.
The soldier kept drinking water inside the metal tank.
The gas station got a new tank this week.
significados_incorretos: A large container used to store liquids.
A metal compartment used to transport fuel.
An industrial reservoir used at gas stations.
impacto_motivo: Tank, in everyday use, points to resilience, holding up through tough situations without giving up, and is seen as a positive trait.

significado: A dominant, confident person who naturally stands out as a leader in a group.
exemplo_correto: He always takes charge of the group's decisions, the classic alpha of the crew.
exemplos_incorretos: The lab tested the alpha version of the app before launch.
The brain's alpha wave shows up during deep states of relaxation.
The dev team fixed the bugs in the game's alpha phase.
significados_incorretos: The first test version of software before its official release.
A type of brain electrical activity associated with calm states.
The early development stage of a digital product.
impacto_motivo: Alpha describes a leadership, confident posture, but it's used so variably and sometimes ironically that it doesn't carry a fixed judgment.

significado: A person seen as submissive, insecure, or lacking initiative, usually used as a criticism.
exemplo_correto: He never decides anything on his own, always asks everyone first, so beta.
exemplos_incorretos: I tested the beta version of the app before it officially launched.
The company opened beta access to the game to a small group of players.
The scientist studied the beta particle emitted during the experiment.
significados_incorretos: A test version of software before its final release.
An evaluation phase of a digital product with limited access.
A type of radiation studied in nuclear physics experiments.
impacto_motivo: Beta is used disparagingly to criticize a lack of initiative or submissiveness, working almost like an insult.

significado: To repeatedly rack up likes, followers, compliments, or engagement on social media.

exemplos_incorretos: My grandpa loves farming vegetables in the backyard.

Tending to a family farm plot.
Working in activities related to cultivating the land.
impacto_motivo: Farm, in a social media context, describes the repeated buildup of engagement, and can be seen neutrally depending on the intent behind it.

A concept tied to spiritual beliefs about personal energy.
impacto_motivo: Aura, in internet slang, playfully celebrates charisma and good moves, associated with positive recognition.

exemplos_incorretos: The 67 bus passes by the corner of my house every twenty minutes.
